يقلعفان (form IVq)
# يَقْلَعِفَّانِ (yaqlaʕiffāni) /jaq.la.ʕif.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# يُقْلَعَفَّانِ (yuqlaʕaffāni) /juq.la.ʕaf.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
